thread:
laura_support: heads up — multiple customers reporting intermittent 502/504s from hosted inference in us-west1 since ~08:30 UTC. earliest spike at 08:28. errors look like gateway-level resets. attaching sample trace id and a quick curl.
aj_sre: thanks — any deploys around that time? can you paste a trace id and an example request? :eyes:
laura_support: no infra deploys flagged but product rolled a small change to auth header propagation at 08:25. one of the customer tickets includes trace id trace-0a7f9c3b. sample curl they used:
laura_support: ```
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" -H "Content-Type: application/json" https://api.redwood-inference.com/v1/hosted/generate -d '{"prompt":"hello"}'
```
mike_runtime: looking at trace-0a7f9c3b — upstream (frontdoor) returns 502 with envoy x-envoy-upstream-service-time ~2ms then downstream client sees 504/stream reset. logs show h2 GOAWAY from midproxy after repeated stream resets.
kevin_customer: from our side we saw repeated fast failures then retries, very short windows between attempts. token rotation was running but should be fine.
aj_sre: suspicious — h2 keepalive/heartbeat mismatch can cause pooled connections to be torn and result in upstream 502s that cascade. did the auth change add a large header or change connection reuse? laura_support, can you confirm header sizes for failing requests?
laura_support: customer provided raw request headers — auth header ~3.8k (long session JWT with extra claims). we do have an auth propagation change that adds `x-tenant-meta` (~300 bytes). combined it nudged some requests above typical size.
mike_runtime: large headers + existing keepalive jitter seen in us-west1 h2 pool. combined effects can overflow per-connection stream window on certain envoys, leading to rapid local ejection. searching for recent envoy ejections... found pattern: 08:27:51 -> conn 10.2.3.45 ejected (pending streams > threshold). repeated ejections correlate with spike.
aj_sre: can you grab a small sample of envoy logs around 08:27-08:33? grep for "ejected", "goaway", "stream reset" and paste lines.
laura_support: pasted minimal lines into thread:
laura_support: ```
[08:27:51] envoy[1532]: upstream ejected conn id=0x7f3a, pending_streams=18, max=16
[08:27:52] envoy[1532]: http2 stream reset CODE:REFUSED_STREAM stream=42
[08:28:03] envoy[1532]: downstream connection reset by peer
[08:28:10] envoy[1532]: envoy router: no healthy upstream
```
mike_runtime: that matches conn pool exhaustion + REFUSED_STREAM. mitigation path: 1) reduce header size (temp) 2) increase per-connection max concurrent streams (config) 3) fallback routing to eu1/dedicated for heavy customers while we patch.
aj_sre: immediate workaround we used previously: enable short-term aggressive fallback routing for tenant IDs hitting >X 5xxs/min. do we have tenant id for kevin_customer?
kevin_customer: tenant is tenant-acme-77. we can accept routing to eu1 for the next 2 hours while you investigate if that helps.
laura_support: routing change initiated to route tenant-acme-77 to eu1 via routing service at 08:45 UTC. also asked customer to remove non-essential JWT claims to shrink token — they confirmed they can rotate a shorter token in 30m.
mike_runtime: recommend rolling patch: set envoy "max_concurrent_streams" on midproxy from 100 to 200 for us-west1 pools and temporarily increase keepalive timeout from 30s->60s to reduce churn. will open infra ticket.
laura_support: filing infra ticket and escalation: INFRA-2026-134. adding logs and sample traces.
aj_sre: good. follow-up actions: - monitor 5xx rate for tenant-acme-77 + region us-west1 - confirm customer token rotation reduces header size - schedule config change during low traffic window with rollout + canary - add guardrail: reject requests with header > 8k with clear 4xx to avoid downstream ejection.
mike_runtime: noted. I'll coordinate the config change and post back ETA.
deploy-bot: deploy request queued: change set "us-west1-h2-pool-concurrency-200" created by mike_runtime. ETA 09:30 UTC canary.
kevin_customer: thanks team — we appreciate quick routing workaround. we'll confirm once token rotated.
laura_support: closing loop for this thread for now. will update when INFRA-2026-134 progresses or customer confirms reduction. :white_check_mark:
